after_answers.agent_answer: Your team's on-call rotation is a paired on-call setup, meaning there are two roles: a primary on-call and a secondary on-call. To manage alerts effectively in this setup, it is important to establish clear communication channels between the primary and secondary on-call members. Defining escalation protocols helps clarify when the secondary should step in. Regular check-ins ensure both members stay aligned on ongoing issues. Using a shared platform for logging alerts and updates keeps both parties informed and helps track the resolution process.
